name: Daurosaurus
isnote: Named a hypsilophodont ornithopod by Alifanov and Saveliev in 2014; its relations to other basal neornithischians such as Kulindadromeus were not tested in the sources used here.
sum: A small basal ornithischian from the Middle Jurassic Ukureyskaya Formation of Transbaikalia, Russia, named in 2014.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; from the Ukureyskaya Formation of the Chita region, Russia.
material: Material from the same fossil site as Kulindadromeus.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Alifanov and Saveliev 2014
